description: Net revenue retention (NRR) and gross revenue retention (GRR) for a cohort of existing customers over a period, usually 12 months: (starting revenue + expansion - contraction - churn) / starting revenue. Above 100% NRR means existing customers grow on their own. Exclude revenue from new customers. Guide: https://raziel.co/learn/evaluating-startup-traction-metrics

churned_usd.description: Revenue lost from customers in that cohort who left.

expansion_usd.description: Upsell and expansion revenue from that cohort.

starting_mrr_usd.description: Recurring revenue from the cohort at the start of the period (MRR or ARR, use the same basis throughout).

name: net_revenue_retention
title: Net and gross revenue retention
